exact_generation_prompt:
Create ONE original sharp realistic premium editorial haircut photograph, NOT a collage, contact sheet, sprite or illustration. The person is a fictional ADULT. HEAD AND SHOULDERS only: complete top of head, all main hair edges, ears and entire haircut silhouette visible, with clear breathing room above the crown and generous margin at both sides. No close crop, no torso emphasis. LOOSE OPAQUE HIGH TURTLENECK LONG-SLEEVED jumper covers neckline and all upper chest, with generous fabric so no chest or torso contour; no low cut, open collar, sleeveless outfit or exposed upper chest. Plain light ivory studio; neutral daylight, sharp face and ALL hair detail, sufficient depth of field; no deliberate blur, bokeh, grain, fog or defocus filter. Natural skin texture, restrained premium salon colour. No text, logos, watermark, jewellery, celebrity likeness, stock or competitor reference. Preserve full source aspect. Render at genuine original native resolution supported by this tool, preferably at least1024pixels long edge. No enlargement or upscaling. a fictional adult white woman with natural fair skin and grey eyes, age 67, wearing a loose opaque ivory HIGH TURTLENECK long-sleeved jumper with very loose fabric covering upper chest completely. Create one original editorial photograph of a fictional adult with a true bob-pixie hybrid. Primary collection: Classic bixie haircuts. Design: soft rounded | soft tapered | wispy | ear-revealing temple pieces | 1-crown-to-front-proportion. Attributes: {"texture": "coily", "strand": "medium", "density": "medium", "length": "medium", "fringe": "wispy", "colour": "copper", "finish": "natural", "age_reference": "adult", "face_reference": "unspecified", "maintenance": "discuss"}. Neutral warm stone setting, natural skin, soft studio daylight, full head/hair/ears/nape visible without crop. Fully covered modest outfit, closed high neckline, long sleeves, no exposed shoulders, chest or back. Portrait 4:5, no words, watermark or logos. Do not substitute an ordinary bob, close pixie or long wolf cut. Render a clearly distinct haircut concept rather than only changing colour or model age. FRONT view: face directly forward and level, both eyes and full front haircut outline visible, no three-quarter turn. Quiet natural expression. Hair/cut attributes in this brief are authoritative; clothing rule is high loose opaque turtleneck.
FULL FRAMING: head and shoulder line only, full sharp hair silhouette surrounded by background margin. Loose opaque oversized tall ivory turtleneck, no neckline/chest/shoulder exposure, no body contours. All hair sharp with no deliberate blur.
CUT STRUCTURE: true bob-pixie hybrid with longer ear-level side shape and a distinctly shorter graduated or tapered nape as specified; never a full bob. TEXTURE CRITICAL: small tight densely spiralling corkscrew COILS, pencil-sized ringlets, not loose waves or broad curls.
AUTHORITATIVE TEXTURE OVERRIDE: natural tightly COILY copper hair, type 4A-like small spring-shaped spirals of about 3-4 millimetres diameter, high curl contraction, tight cylindrical corkscrews from roots through tips. NOT broad curls, NOT waves, NOT loose ringlets. Soft rounded crown; delicate wispy fringe made of a few tiny separated spring coils, ear-revealing temple coils, soft tapered nape. Close-spaced tiny coils must be visibly distinct from a loose curly style.

shape_brief.distinctness_basis: soft rounded | soft tapered | wispy | ear-revealing temple pieces | 1-crown-to-front-proportion
